pr.body:
Completed private cycles now expose a bound review and explicit next-block preview. Confirmation atomically saves the reflection, private version, next cycle/schedule, goal transition and immutable receipt. Cancellation and exact retries preserve historical actuals. Carried goals have deferred baselines; continuing without a new goal creates none.

The local Coach uses typed, confirmed capabilities and recoverable setup/memory drafts. Dated review choices now use a native confirmation modal, recover the latest valid saved continuation after cold start, and show it before details. Continue opens the editable guided setup summary; a newer Keep plan suppresses the older action. SQLite initialization owns and closes its connection across failures/remounts, with stale-result guards and sanitized diagnostics. Elapsed workout duration is explicitly labeled; mixed-unit records name known normalized units. Public content remains gated for qualified review, and core training remains guest-only, local and deterministic.

Validation:

- Latest app source b00e62ac: full `npm run verify` exit 0, **1,173 tests / 144 suites**, Doctor 21/21, security/vendor/config/audit checks and both mobile exports. Native standalone x86_64 release build/install passed.
- Pixel 7 emulator / Android 16 API36, WHPX: latest dated continuation survives cold start, appears at normal/200% text and opens reviewed editable setup. Cancellation/navigation exports retain all 36 record sections / 1,079 records. Three foreground font-change rounds pass nine fresh-screen checks and retain all records.
- Explicit Keep plan confirmation adds exactly one predecessor-linked receipt, then survives cold start without offering the older continuation. External receiver JSON contains 1,080 records, with all 35 other sections unchanged.
- Earlier frozen candidates observed atomic handover/cold receipt recovery, deferred baseline/no-new-goal behavior, deletion and exact native-picker restore/re-export, visible refusals and elapsed-time/unit labels. Each report identifies its own source and binary; those cases were not all rerun on b00.
- Remote CI at older 3738e8f3 completed Android/unsigned iOS compilation, payload proof and iOS simulator install/cold launch. It does not cover the new app source or full iOS journeys. New-head remote CI remains pending until its own terminal evidence is available.

The original db4 recreation/database retry failure remains documented: cold start recovered unchanged records, causal origin unproven. The later stress pass does not certify deliberately induced native failure/warm retry. Route intents delivered during activity destruction were classified separately as a refused harness mismatch. No participant, physical-device, screen-reader or six-week acceptance is inferred.

[Latest Coach QA, screenshots, exports and exact run instructions](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e3abffce/docs/50_LOCAL_COACH_REVIEW_QA.md) · [Atomic handover QA](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e3abffce/docs/47_ATOMIC_HANDOVER_QA.md) · [Memory/guided setup QA](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e3abffce/docs/49_LOCAL_COACH_NATIVE_QA.md) · [Reconciled TODO](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e3abffce/docs/43_SHIPPING_GOAL_AND_TODO.md)

All **52 open issues** remain mapped and open. Provisional engineering score stays **53/100** under doc34; human acceptance is unverified. Repeat-week runtime, compact-date proposal acceptance, full current iOS/physical Android journeys, assistive technology, qualified public content, signing/support and store acceptance remain pending. Disabled Gemini preparation is separate PR350. This draft is stacked on #349 and includes no merge, deployment, paid activation, store submission or issue closure.
